name: HashiCorp Vault MCP Server
description: Enables language models to securely manage HashiCorp Vault secrets and ACL policies through the Model Context Protocol. It supports automated secret rotation, discovery, and HCL policy authoring using a suite of dedicated tools and resources.

rawRecord.description: Enables language models to securely manage HashiCorp Vault secrets and ACL policies through the Model Context Protocol. It supports automated secret rotation, discovery, and HCL policy authoring using a suite of dedicated tools and resources.

VAULT_ADDR.description: URL of the Vault cluster, for example https://vault.internal:8200 or http://127.0.0.1:8200.

VAULT_TOKEN.description: Short-lived or renewable Vault token starting with hvs.. Scope it tightly using Vault policies.

VAULT_CACERT.description: Path to a CA bundle used for verifying self-signed certificates.

VAULT_NAMESPACE.description: Optional Vault namespace if your deployment requires it; the server forwards the process environment to the Vault client library.

NODE_TLS_REJECT_UNAUTHORIZED.description: Set to 0 only for testing with self-signed certificates. Prefer adding proper CA bundles instead.
